{category}geography.short_description: State name, or "United States" for the national total.
{category}geography.long_description: Geographic area the row describes, as a state name or "United States" for the national total.

{category}geography_fips.short_description: FIPS code for the geography; "00" is national.
{category}geography_fips.long_description: FIPS code for the row's geography, with "00" for the national total and 2-digit codes for states.

{category}date.short_description: End date of the reporting period, in YYYY-mm-dd format.
{category}date.long_description: End date of the reporting period the row covers.

{category}year.long_description: Year of the reporting period, the MMWR year for the weekly NNDSS series.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|pat.short_description: Group A or Group B Streptococcus.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|pat.long_description: Bacterial species the row describes, Group A Streptococcus (Streptococcus pyogenes) or Group B Streptococcus (Streptococcus agalactiae).

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|rat.long_name: Population the rate is relative to
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|rat.short_description: Whether a rate is per 100,000 of the row's stratum or of the whole population.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|rat.long_description: Which population a per-100,000 rate is relative to, either the stratum the row describes or the whole population.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|age.short_description: Age group; "Total" is the all-ages aggregate.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|age.long_description: Age group the row reports, with "Total" as the all-ages aggregate.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|sex.long_description: Sex of the cases the row describes, reported for Group A only.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|rac.short_description: Race and ethnicity; "Total" combines all groups.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|rac.long_description: Race and ethnicity of the cases the row describes, collapsed by ABCs to White, Black and Other.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|ons.short_description: Early- or late-onset infant Group B disease.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|ons.long_description: Whether infant Group B disease had early onset (0-6 days of life) or late onset (7-89 days).

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|syn.short_description: Clinical presentation the row describes; "Total" where not syndrome-specific.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|syn.long_description: Clinical presentation the row reports, for the syndrome measures.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|ant.short_description: Drug the resistance percentage refers to; "Total" where not drug-specific.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|ant.long_description: Antibiotic a pct_resistant row refers to.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|emm.short_description: emm type the row describes; "Total" where not type-specific.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|emm.long_description: emm type of the Group A Streptococcus isolates, the M protein gene sequence type.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|ser.short_description: Capsular serotype the row describes; "Total" where not serotype-specific.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|ser.long_description: Capsular serotype of the Group B Streptococcus isolates.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|alp.short_description: Alpha-like protein gene the row describes; "Total" where not type-specific.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|alp.long_description: Alpha-like protein (ALPH) surface gene type of the Group B Streptococcus isolates.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|val.short_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|val.long_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column, whose units differ by measure; blank where CDC published nothing, so a 0 is always a measured zero.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_i.short_description: Isolate count behind the percentage on this row.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_i.long_description: Number of isolates the percentage on this row is calculated over.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_i.short_description: Whether n_isolates is published, unpublished, or not applicable.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_i.long_description: Whether n_isolates is published, applies but was not published, or does not apply to the measure.

not_reported.short_description: The measure has an isolate denominator but CDC published none for this row.

not_applicable.short_description: The measure has no isolate denominator.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_t.long_name: Number of isolates of this type
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_t.short_description: Isolates of the emm type on this row.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_t.long_description: Number of isolates of the emm type on this row, the numerator behind pct_emm_type.

bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_t.short_description: Whether n_type is published, unpublished, or not applicable.
bundle_strep/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_t.long_description: Whether n_type is published, applies but was not published, or does not apply to the measure.

reported.short_description: n_type holds CDC's published per-type count.

not_reported.short_description: An emm type CDC did not itemise that year.

bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|week.short_description: MMWR week number (1-53); blank for the quarterly Epic rows.
bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|week.long_description: MMWR (epidemiological) week number within the year, for the weekly NNDSS rows.

bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|age.short_description: Age group; "Total" is the all-ages aggregate.
bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|age.long_description: Epic Cosmos age band for the row, with "Total" as the all-ages aggregate and on every NNDSS row.

bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|sour.short_description: Which surveillance system reported the row.
bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|sour.long_description: Which surveillance system the row comes from, Epic Cosmos or NNDSS.

Epic Cosmos.short_description: Strep throat diagnoses among Epic Cosmos patients, quarterly by state and age.

NNDSS.short_description: Nationally notifiable streptococcal toxic shock syndrome cases, weekly by state.

stss_cases_weekly.long_name: Weekly incident cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome
stss_cases_weekly.short_description: Newly reported STSS cases in the MMWR week.
stss_cases_weekly.long_description: Incident cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome newly reported in the MMWR week.

stss_cases_cumulative.short_description: Year-to-date STSS cases as published by NNDSS.
stss_cases_cumulative.long_description: Cumulative streptococcal toxic shock syndrome cases reported since the start of the MMWR year.

bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|valu.short_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column.
bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|valu.long_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column, whose units differ by measure.

bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|supp.short_description: 1 where Epic withheld the underlying cell; blank on NNDSS rows.
bundle_strep/dist/gas_state.parquet|supp.long_description: 1 where Epic Cosmos withheld the underlying cell as a count of 10 or fewer, in which case the value was imputed as 5; blank on NNDSS rows, which have no such mechanism.
